Egg Fried Rice with Pork.pitch: Cold rice tossed raw in egg yolks so every grain fries separately in gold, tossed with crispy diced smoked ham or pork and scallions for a dry, fluffy, nutty finish.

Egg Fried Rice with Pork.title: Yangzhou-style fried rice with sweet green peas and tender pork
Egg Fried Rice with Pork.pitch: Diced pork, soft egg curds, and sweet green peas stir-fried with fragrant rice, kept pale, clean, and aromatic with Shaoxing wine and sea salt rather than heavy dark soy.

Egg Fried Rice with Pork.title: Chili crisp and garlic butter fried rice with crispy minced pork
Egg Fried Rice with Pork.pitch: Savory pork crisped in the wok, tossed with jasmine rice in sizzling garlic butter and crunchy chili crisp, finished with scallion greens and toasted sesame.
